name: Unveil the Forgotten
source:
In the heart of modern-day Slovakia, myths and old legends are hidden, just beneath the surface of ordinary life. You are an ordinary mortal, Adam, who finds himself pulled into a small village,  one where Slavic gods still walk among mortals disguised as ordinary folks. They blend in as baristas, neighbors, or strangers on the street, but their eyes carry the weight of memories that people forgot for centuries. Now he finds himself exploring the atmosphere of sleepy time while getting to know interesting and mysterious guys. 

[From [url=https://lumifly-gaming.itch.io/unveil-the-forgotten]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在现代斯洛伐克的中心地带，神话和古老的传说隐藏在日常生活的表面之下。亚当，你是一个普通的凡人，他发现自己被拉进了一个小村庄，那里的斯拉夫诸神仍然行走在伪装成普通人的凡人中间。他们以咖啡师、邻居或街上的陌生人的身份融入其中，但他们的眼睛承载着人们几个世纪以来遗忘的记忆。现在，他发现自己在探索昏昏欲睡的氛围，同时结识了有趣而神秘的人。

[来自[url=https://lumifly-gaming.itch.io/unveil-the-forgotten]itch.io[/url]]
